sensitivity_analysis.description: Top 10 variables by impact on monthly income
sensitivity_analysis.methodology: One-at-a-time sensitivity with ±20% perturbation around base case (Normal 4h/day)

top_10_variables.interpretation: Context switching, fatigue, learning directly scale output
Reputation, skill, platform access directly scale acceptance
Base acceptance probability is fundamental gate
Platform payout levels directly scale EV
Inverse relationship - fewer hours per task = more tasks per hour
Frequency only matters if task supply is binding (rarely)
Duplicates waste human time without payout
Longer latency reduces capital velocity and reinvestment

sensitivity_analysis.key_insight: Duplicating the success rate (acceptance probability) is worth more than any financial optimization. The top 6 variables have identical elasticity - improving any of them by 20% yields exactly 20% more income. The #1 leverage point is avoiding duplicates (elasticity -0.45).
